errors.text_span: 图表的水平轴为类别轴，列出了从“Top100”至“Top1000”的十个层级，按数值递增顺序从下至上排列；垂直轴为值轴，其刻度范围从0至400
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the horizontal axis as the category axis and the vertical axis as the value axis. The image is a horizontal bar chart where the vertical axis lists the categories (e.g., Top100, Top200) and the horizontal axis represents the numerical values (from 0 to 400).
The description states that the value for "介动紧密度" (collocational tightness) at the Top100 level is approximately 20. The chart shows the corresponding orange bar has a value of approximately 10.
